sentences.en: An axe in the house keeps the carpenter away.
sentences.zh: 屋子里有把斧头就会让木匠离得远远的。

sentences.en: The suspect was last seen wearing paint-splattered carpenter pants.
sentences.zh: 最后看到嫌疑人时他穿着满是油漆污渍的工装裤，像是个木匠穿的那种。

sentences.en: Abraham Lincoln's father was a carpenter by trade.
sentences.zh: 亚伯拉罕·林肯的父亲以做木匠为生。
